resenas.texto: Overland Restoration was an absolute lifesaver and a God send! From the first phone call to the final walkthrough, their team was professional, prompt, super knowledgeable, and very reassuring. They handled the mold remediation carefully, explained every step clearly, and left my home spotless. Honestly I felt like they treated my home as if it were their own. I would recommend Overland Restoration wholeheartedly. I truly believe that God sent them to us in our time of an emergency. The owner Danny was so thorough and professional also very kind and sincere. Thank you for everything you have done for our family and our home! If I could give them 10 stars I would!

When I called, Danny answered the phone immediately. We discussed the issues and I felt very comfortable with his company. He was honest, quick to respond and did the job at a price better than my other 3 quotes. I cannot say enough about how happy I am, even the HOA commented on the great job he did. I highly recommend Overland Restoration to anyone. He is a small company and does the work himself with a small crew. GREAT JOB...

I reserve Google reviews for companies that deliver truly exceptional service, and Overland Restoration did exactly that. After closing on our new waterfront condominium in Bonita Springs, we were excited to begin renovations—only to be devastated when we discovered mold beneath the old flooring. From our first contact with owner Danny LaBau, his responsiveness, professionalism, and reassuring approach made a difficult situation much easier to navigate. Danny and his team were diligent and thorough, demonstrating a genuine commitment to resolving the mold issue completely. Throughout the process, we felt confident that our family’s health and safety were a priority. They handled the mold removal and restoration with care and efficiency, giving us much-needed peace of mind. Just as importantly, Danny operates his business with integrity. His pricing was fair, his communication was excellent, and he was an absolute pleasure to work with. We are grateful for the outstanding service and recommend Overland Restoration without hesitation.

Great experience. Danny came out quickly to assess the situation and provide an estimate. Communicated the project clearly so I could understand what was being done. Started the work quickly and communicated through the whole project. Provided a picture report of the project from start to finish. Incredible service and attention to detail. One of the best experiences working with a contractor that I have had. Highly recommend.

We Had such a great experience with Danny at Overland Restoration !! He is so knowledgeable and thorough in every way ! He walks you through the plan , what to expect in terms of timing , cost , clean up and every detail related to mitigating the mold . He went above and beyond making sure the home was clean , safe and meticulously put back together .! We were so blessed to work with him and very very highly recommend him !! He made a very unnerving mold situation feel manageable and all of us safe again ! We also had several estimates, he wasn’t the cheapest or most expensive he was absolutely fair ! Thank you Danny and God bless your future projects ! Stay safe !!

Danny (Overland Restoration 24/7) quickly and thoroughly did a master bathroom bathroom shower mold remediation at my just sold condo on short notice for a fast closing. I have been a home owner for nearly 45 years and had many contractors do work. None surpasses Danny for expertise, integrity, responsiveness, clear communication, passion for doing the job right - completely above and beyond at a reasonable price. Can't recommend Danny and his company highly enough.5 stars is not enough.. Already I have referred him to multiple other customers. Simply the best.

Dani did an outstanding job repairing our condo over a single weekend. His workmanship was exceptional, and he kept us informed every step of the way with clear and consistent communication. What really stood out was his transparency, reliability, and strong work ethic—qualities that are hard to find. Because of this experience, he has officially become our full-time contractor. I highly recommend Dani to anyone looking for a trustworthy, hardworking, and professional contractor. You’ll be in great hands.

Danny LeDau was a godsend. He was ready to start the restoration on my bathroom leaks right away. He is professional and always came to work with a smile and told me it was going to be ok. I highly recommend him and his company. They do excellent work!

Overland Restoration did a fantastic job on a mold remediation project at my home in Naples. They were thorough, professional, knowledgable, and had a terrific work ethic. I don’t think you could go wrong by hiring Danny and his team! I’m so grateful Danny was available to do my project and I would hire him again if I was in need of his services. He went over and beyond my expectations!
Work was exceptional after a cooking fire in my kitchen The calming explanation of what Danny would do to rectify the damage is noteworthy To see the results is to see a new house JFC

We had an excellent experience with this mold remediation company. Danny did work on our property in Naples and was professional, knowledgeable, reliable, very honest, and detail oriented. He truly went above and beyond running the machines longer and doing extra work outside the original scope just to be helpful. Our home was left extremely clean and it passed testing with flying colors. Highly recommend this company, Danny is wonderful to work with!

Danny was easy to work with. He helped get our Sanibel home repaired after the hurricanes. He knows his construction business well and was punctual. Danny got the work done as soon as possible. He gave us the right papers we needed for insurance. Danny was our life saver at a time of terrible stress. We appreciated all his help and his explanations and his concern. He is very thoughtful and knowledgeable. He gave us good advice. We would highly recommend him.

Danny went above and beyond to get my wife and I back in our home. he worked the weekend when others would not and his attention to detail was fantastic. i highly recommend Overland Restoration and Danny. if you need this type of service choose Overland.
Danny, Overland Restoration, did his work in a timely manner. He is thorough and left everything in tip/top shape. I would highly recommend him.
Danny from Overland Restoration did very good job. He kept in constant communication and did really good work.
Danny and company did a great job at my rental property. He went above and beyond. Highly recommend!
The absolute best and most reliable company I’ve ever worked with! I highly recommend it! Professionals at its best!

Overland restoration was amazing. Danny was more than helpful he took charge of cleaning up my condo on Bonita Beach in Florida when I could not be there !!!He handled everything for us through emails and over the phone !!! He saved my unit from being damaged further by getting in there and getting the job done. Overland restoration is the company to call !! I have nothing but great things to say about them !! Leslie Izzo Bonita beach
Reliable and trustworthy company, Danny and his team were professional, efficient, and very knowledgeable

Danny was so responsive and helped us out of a bind. We were in a tough spot as we were selling a home in Fl from a different state. There were some water damage issues that had to be mitigated immediately in order to close on property, he was able to do that at a very reasonable price. We are so grateful to have found him. He was on time, communicative, and his work was excellent. Far exceeded expectations! Mark

My wife & I own 2 homes in the same community one we live in & the other we have in the past rented out. We decided to sell the rental. There was much work needed to be done. Danny & his men proceeded to repair & renovate many areas in our rental. The quality & workmanship was A-1. They were able to meet all of our needs. There preparation & abilities to complete every job was amazing. When Danny & company were finished other then what was repaired you couldn’t tell there were workman working there. The home was left immaculate. We were so happy with there work that they then came to our other home to do another job that needed attention. I would use and recommend Danny Labau for any future work needed. I believe Danny does his work like if it was on his own home. For us Danny gets a “10”
Danny Labau is trust worty, kind, helpful and efficient. Hie teams were my Ian Recovery Mitigation group. If you need help, call Danny Labau today. Julianne Ream
